title: Word Search II: One Walk for Every Word
summary: Search the board once, following the board and a trie of all the words together, and prune what's been found.

takeaway.summary: Build one trie of all the words. From each cell, walk the board only along letters the current trie node has as children; collect words at their ends, and remove trie branches once they're empty.
takeaway.timeComplexity: O(cells × 4^L) at worst, far less with pruning
whenToUse: Finding many words on one board

scenes.narration: A 2 by 3 board reads c a t over o r e. Which of cat, car, care, and cot can be traced by stepping to neighboring cells?
scenes.caption: Board c a t / o r e: find cat, car, care, cot

scenes.narration: Searching the board once per word walks the same c, a paths again and again. Instead, put every word in one trie and walk the board just once.
scenes.caption: Searching the board once per word repeats the same paths

scenes.narration: All four words go into one trie: cat, car, and care share c a, and cot shares just the c.
scenes.caption: One trie: cat, car, care share c, a; cot shares c

scenes.narration: From the top-left c: c is a child of the root, so the walk steps onto it.
scenes.caption: Start at c: it's a child of the root

scenes.narration: Down to o: c o is in the trie, waiting for a t, but the only free neighbor is r, and c o has no r. Dead end after one letter, so turn back.
scenes.caption: c, o: no t touches o, and r isn't a child of co

scenes.narration: Back at c, step right to a, then down to r: c a r ends a word. Collect car, and clear its mark so it isn't found twice.
scenes.caption: c, a, r ends car: collect it

scenes.narration: From r, step right to e: care. Collect it too.
scenes.caption: r, e ends care: collect it

scenes.narration: Walking back, the r and e branches are now empty, so they're removed from the trie. From a, step right to t: cat.
scenes.caption: Back up, then a, t: cat. Emptied branches are removed

scenes.narration: No other cell is a c, so no other walk starts. Only cot is left in the trie, and it has no path on the board.
scenes.caption: No other cell starts a word: cot has no path

scenes.narration: Put every word in one trie and walk the board once, stepping only onto letters the trie allows. Found words are cleared and empty branches pruned.
scenes.caption: One trie, one walk: the board and the trie move together
